selected_claim: For the MLP-only PWEMoE configuration on CLIP-ViT-B/32, the trainable router parameter counts in Table 10 are 264, 540, and 3.36K for 2, 3, and 8 tasks respectively, and the count is independent of backbone width.
limitations: Reproduces the architectural parameter-count claim, not accuracy, hypervolume, memory, or wall-time benchmarks.
Uses the router dimensions stated in Section 4 and the 12 CLIP-ViT-B/32 MLP blocks implied by the reported counts.

comparison.rationale: Parameter counts are deterministic integer consequences of the published router dimensions.
